title: Which roadmap? It depends on the reader

beats.say: Archie unveils his roadmap to Penny. Every component. Tiny print.
Penny's eyes glaze over. What does the business get?
Executives get a capability roadmap. Component roadmaps are for engineers.
Roughly twelve to twenty-four months. Not a five-year plan.
Which roadmap? For once, it depends is exactly right.

facts.claim: Don't give executives a component roadmap or engineers a capability roadmap.
facts.evidence: Don't give executives a component roadmap or engineers a capability roadmap

facts.claim: A capability roadmap tells executives which capabilities will be enabled in a timeframe.
facts.evidence: A capability roadmap tells executives which capabilities will be enabled in a timeframe

facts.claim: A roadmap is a phased plan for roughly the next 12 to 24 months.
facts.evidence: a phased plan for roughly the next 12 to 24 months

facts.claim: A roadmap is not a five-year long-range plan.
facts.evidence: it is not a statement of work, a requirements document, a five-year long-range plan
